name: atmos
description: Atmos. Find the conditions. Capture the moment. UK landscape photography and hill-walking conditions planner.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p apps/alerts && pnpm --filter web check
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-data.ts --out apps/web/static/data && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.bundle:data: esbuild scripts/build-data.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/build-data.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
